notablePrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying the targeted creature.
When the creature dies, Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
